thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planned tiny backfill + schema add tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Please read and ack.
Maya: Summary: add column user_profiles.email_normalized (nullable), start backfill in waves, rate-limit to avoid lock contention.
Maya: Rollout plan: 1) apply schema (instant, nullable col) 08:00 2) canary backfill on 5% tenants 08:05 (deploybot will run) 3) ramp by 5% every 5m, max 50k rows/min 4) final sweep 02:00 maintenance window if needed.
Raj: ACK — oncall aware?
Maya: @ops-oncall yes, pinged. ops-oncall: I'm on for 08:00-09:00 UTC. Watching locks and replica lag.
Sam: quick question — any FK checks or index rebuilds?
Maya: No FK or rebuilds. Just update normalized email and populate from lowercase(trim(email)). No index changes.
Evan: Can you paste the SQL we'll run for backfill?
Maya: Sure — small snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_profiles ADD COLUMN email_normalized text;
UPDATE user_profiles SET email_normalized = lower(trim(email)) WHERE email_normalized IS NULL AND email IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10000;
```
Maya: We'll use the rate-limited updater job (backfill-worker) that batches by tenant and respects DB connections.
Raj: What's the abort/rollback criteria?
Maya: Abort if: 1) >5s p99 write latency increase for user-facing services, 2) replica lag >30s sustained, 3) deploybot canary fails to finish two consecutive waves.
Sam: Add outage plan: if we abort, revert is just stop backfill and drop column later if needed. No destructive swap.
deploybot: canary started for thread 1786543210: launching 5% tenant subset backfill at 08:05 UTC. Canary id: cb-178654.
srebot: Observability hooks live — dashboard link: https://grafana.company/internal/d/user_profiles_backfill (watch p99 writes, replica lag, deadlocks).
ops-oncall: Noted. I'll escalate to DB infra if locks show up.
Evan: Suggestion — run the first canary on a low-traffic region to be safe.
Maya: good call. Canary will use eu-west-1 subset.
Raj: I'll stand by for pinning app version if we need to roll forward a quick fix. Which release contains the backfill job?
Maya: backfill-worker v2.4.0. If we need to pin, pin to v2.3.8.
Sam: Leave a manual holdpoint at 08:30 before ramping above 20%.
Maya: Done — manual holdpoint added. I'll post status at each holdpoint.
deploybot: canary cb-178654: wave 1 complete, 1.2k rows updated, no deadlocks detected.
Maya: wave 1 looks good. Holding for manual ack.
Raj: +1, no issues on service metrics.
ops-oncall: seeing normal latencies, replica lag stable. :thumbsup:
Maya: OK proceeding to wave 2 (10% total).
deploybot: canary cb-178654: wave 2 complete, 6.5k rows, small transient spike in commit time (200ms) but p99 within threshold.
srebot: Alert rule check — no alerts triggered.
Evan: If we start seeing lock wait >200ms, throttle to 10k rows/min.
Maya: noted — throttle rule ready.
Sam: reminder to update release notes: "Add email_normalized column + staged backfill. No user-visible downtime."
Maya: I'll add release notes after final sweep.
deploybot: canary cb-178654: ramping to 50% per plan.
Maya: final sweep scheduled 02:00 UTC in maintenance window; will re-run for any remaining tenants with low traffic.
Raj: ACK. If anything goes sideways, we'll stop backfill and revert by stopping the worker and opening a rollback issue.
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll post postmortem link and final counts after completion.
ops-oncall: Thanks — monitoring pinned.
Sam: :party-parrot: good run.
Maya: closing thread once sweep done.
